sources.title: Estiatorio Milos Hudson Yards reviews | Exa place listing
sources.text: Lovely view of the Vessel landmarks and city. Great spot for business or elegant evening. Loved the food and I think the fried calamari was the softest fluffiest delicious fried thing I've ever had! 2 thumbs up for the fried octopus! Stairs and elevators so would say it's accessible as well. Had an incredible experience at Milos in Hudson Yards! The atmosphere was elegant yet welcoming, and the food was absolutely top-notch—fresh, flavorful, and beautifully prepared. But what truly made the night special was the outstanding service from Mario at the bar. He was beyond attentive, knowledgeable about the menu, and made the best recommendations. His passion for hospitality really stood out, and he created such a warm and engaging experience. Whether you’re stopping by for a drink or dining in, Mario’s service elevates the whole experience. Will definitely be back!

summary.value: Estiatorio Milos Hudson Yards is a high-end Greek seafood restaurant at 20 Hudson Yards, Fifth Floor, where Milos' signature fish market showcases the daily catch and diners pick their fish. Restaurantji guests rate it 4.2 717 ratings and praise an amazing view of Hudson River and Hudson Yards, while Tripadvisor (search snapshot) shows 4.3 of 5 bubbles. It suits a business lunch, a date or a celebration, with prices to match.

description.value: Estiatorio Milos Hudson Yards is a Greek restaurant at 20 Hudson Yards, Fifth Floor. The restaurant offers the matchless seafood of Milos served high up, with unrivaled views of the spectacular sunsets over the Hudson River. Book a sunset table if the view matters. OpenTable diners rate Estiatorio Milos Hudson Yards 4.8 from 1,503 reviews. Tripadvisor travelers (search snapshot) call it Great place for a business lunch or a date, though one July 2026 review said the service was somewhat slow and The prawns had a bad taste but were quite expensive.
